title: Falling With the Least Harm: How Long Before the Ground, Whether There Is Time to Recover, and Going Soft to Spread the Blow

questions.question: What decides between trying to recover and going soft?
options: Whether the time to the ground is more than a recovery step needs

questions.question: The quick fall took how long to reach the ground?
questions.explanation: With a tilt of 23 degrees at 3.0 rad/s.

questions.question: What was the quick fall told to do?
questions.explanation: There was no time for a step.

questions.question: Soft legs gave a landing force of:
Why is a tiny tilt not 'about to fall'?
options: The balance control holds it, and the time to the ground only means something when it is not
questions.explanation: An inverted pendulum with any tilt falls in the end.

questions.question: Should a robot that has fallen get straight up?
options: No: its motors may be hot or a leg bent; check first (36-02)
questions.explanation: Getting up is among the hardest things.
